'''Jeremy LaMere''' won the [[1997 Tatooine Regionals (Phoenix)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

The 36-player event was hosted by [[William Schmidt]], and LaMere beat Brandon Allen in the final.<ref name="decsq-schmidtwilliam">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/schmidtwilliam.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Gold 18 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000607001535/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/schmidtwilliam.html Internet Archive]</ref>
